title: Lowo Othole I-Surah
intro: Cabanga ngomphefumulo othobekile usondela komunye wezithunywa zika-Allah onenhliziyo egcwele ubuqotho kanye nesifiso esijulile sokufunda. Kodwa ngaleso sikhathi, umuntu ocebile nesikhundla wabamba ukunaka kwezithunywa, kwathi ukuhwaqabala kwaqondiswa kulowo ofunayo. Okwalandela kwaba isahluko esiphelele se-Quran, esasithunyelwe ukulungisa izithunywa nokuhlonipha umphefumulo ozayo ofuna.
clues: Ngafika kuMthunywa ka-Allah ngenhliziyo evulekile kanye nesifiso esijulile sokuqondiswa
Ngangingenaso isimo sezwe engingasinikeza, umphefumulo othobekile kuphela ofuna iqiniso
Amehlo ami enyama ayengaboni, kodwa umbono wami ongokomoya wawucacile
Ngafika ngesikhathi esingesihle, lapho uMthunywa wayematasa nomuntu onethonya elikhulu
Ukububula kwaphendukela kimi, kodwa u-Allah waphendula ngokulungisa kwaphezulu
Ngingu-Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, umngane ozinikele ondaba yakhe yaphefumulela iSurah Abasa.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: U-Allah wenza umlilo waphola futhi waphephile kimi
